messages:
Lina (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock the curation + staggered onboarding cadence for the next DP cohort starting Apr 6. Target: 6 active partners across three waves.
Ravi (Design): 👍 3 waves of 2 each sounds good. prefer Wave A to be engineering-heavy so we validate infra assumptions early.
Noah (Research): Agree. Also propose we split feedback into exploratory vs. acceptance metrics. Exploratory = feature discovery interviews; acceptance = success criteria we can measure.
Grace (Solutions): Ops note — we should surface per-partner runbooks: integration checklist, sample prompts, expected throughput. Can we commit a Notion template?
Lina (PM): Yes. I'll create the template today. Key asks: recruitment sources, incentives, onboarding schedule, feedback cadence, and exit criteria.
Ravi (Design): Recruitment sources: existing DP list, customer success referrals, and 2 targeted outreach emails to mid-market product teams. Incentive: $1k credit + priority support. Thoughts?
Noah (Research): Works. For feedback cadence: 15-min daily async check-ins first 3 days of onboarding, then weekly 30-min interviews + biweekly written survey. Use a short NPS + 3 open questions.
Grace (Solutions): Also add a one-week technical health check (latency/cost smoke tests) and a 30-day operational review. That gives us quantitative signals.
Lina (PM): Success criteria candidates (we'll make pass/fail gates): 1) integration completed within 1 week for 4/6 partners; 2) median token latency within SLA for 80% of requests; 3) at least 3 tracked product improvements (UX or perf) from partner feedback.
Ravi (Design): For UX feedback capture — we'll use an in-app lightweight recorder for prompt flows + a shared Loom channel. Keep post-session tasks <= 10m for partners.
Noah (Research): Data capture plan: annotate 20 prompt examples per partner, categorize false positives/ hallucinations, and run A/B prompt variants for 2 high-impact flows.
Grace (Solutions): Dependencies: dedicated support slot (2hrs/week) from infra, access to staging credentials, and a rollback plan for traffic spikes. Can infra commit?
Lina (PM): I'll ping infra separately. For rollout cadence: Wave 1 onboarding Apr 6–12, Wave 2 Apr 13–19, Wave 3 Apr 20–26. Doable?
Ravi (Design): Fine with design schedule. Can we time a mid-wave design review after Wave 1? Prefer Apr 15.
Noah (Research): Makes sense — schedule research interviews starting Apr 8 so we have early qualitative signals.
Grace (Solutions): ops-bot: please create DP Slack channel, calendar invites for the 3 wave kickoffs, and the Notion template link.
ops-bot: created channel #dp-staggered-onboard, invites sent to participants. Notion template: https://notion.fake/r/DP-Onboard-Template. Calendar events created for Apr 6/13/20 kickoffs. :white_check_mark:
Lina (PM): Next steps: I will share the recruitment copy by EOD, Ravi will draft the onboarding checklist, Noah will prepare interview guides, Grace will confirm infra slot. Sync tomorrow 10am.
Ravi (Design): copying recruitment copy into the channel now. I'll add checklist items inline.
Noah (Research): interview guide draft uploaded to Notion.
Grace (Solutions): infra slot confirmed: Tue/Thu 10–12 during the cohort window.
Lina (PM): Awesome — wrapping this. If anyone identifies blockers ping me directly. :celebrate:
